expected: Both native database and frozen-file PIT receipts validate against the same immutable daily lease, C-day population and explicitly configured source identity. Missing, mismatched or substituted file bindings fail closed; no DB fallback.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
